snippet.title: Kebab Chefs! - Bakery Free DLC Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Paris! Kebab Chefs - Bakery DLC will take you on a brand new cullinary experience set in a whole different map!

In this new adventure, you're taking over a cozy bakery shop where you will be baking a variety of colourful sweets and decorating them with frosting and sprinkles of your choice. Show off your barista skills by brewing the perfect espresso shot!

Kebab Chefs - Bakery Free DLC is available for free on August 8, 2025!

Bakery DLC will remain available for free throughout the Early Access of Kebab Chefs!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821410
Join our discord community! https://discord.gg/ceY3MyS

X: https://x.com/bgameworks
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kebabchefs
Website: https://biotechgameworks.com/
